title: IVG Savr 3000 Berry Ice Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Berry Ice IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pods deliver a medley of juicy Mixed Berries topped with a cool Menthol edge. The blend balances sweet and tangy berry notes with a refreshing finish for a smooth and satisfying MTL vape. Each refill pack contains a 2ml pod filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a 4ml refill reservoir. Once connected, the system auto-refills the pod during use — no spills, refills, or coil swaps needed. Designed for use with the IVG Savr 3000 device only. How to Set Up IVG Savr Prefilled Pod's Step 1: Unpack the Device Remove the cap from the mouthpiece. Take out the silicone stopper from the pod. Step 2: Prepare the Refill Peel off the red sticker. Remove the rubber stop. Step 3: Connect the Pod Align the refill with the pod. Press until you hear a click. Step 4: Insert into Device Slide the full pod-and-refill unit into the Savr device. Step 5: Prime the Coil Wait a few minutes to let the coil fully saturate. ✅ Ready to Vape! Inhale to activate and enjoy.
